facts.fact: StackAdapt published its announcement of the LiveRamp partnership on May 7, 2019.
Under the StackAdapt and LiveRamp partnership, StackAdapt clients can onboard a brand's CRM data onto the StackAdapt platform for targeting through native, display and video advertising channels.
facts.quote: StackAdapt clients can now onboard a brand’s CRM data onto the StackAdapt platform for targeting through native, display and video advertising channels.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, LiveRamp handles the entire ingestion of CRM lists, and StackAdapt receives only de-identified data via the sync, so StackAdapt is never exposed to the sensitive 1st-party data.
facts.quote: LiveRamp handles the entire ingestion of CRM lists and then, via the sync with StackAdapt, passes de-identified data that can then be targeted.
